verdict.rationale: Official docs say to write the Omarchy ISO to a USB stick and answer five questions to get a finished desktop, and point to dual-boot and unattended install guides. Hands-on community reports confirm downloading the ISO, booting it and an uncomplicated install. Missing for 10: step-by-step first-party guidance on creating the bootable USB (recommended flashing tools, BIOS/boot settings), and detail beyond one-line docs mentions.
